channel.desc: 3ABN Today welcomes Ostap Dzyndra, Founder of Build and Restore International, as he shares powerful stories of how God has provided for the ministry and opened doors to serve in Mexico, Costa Rica, and the USA. Hear testimonies of transformation, divine leading, and the miracles that happen when we step out in faith to help others.
